govt_add.name: SEE (Secondary Education Examination, National Examinations Board Grade 10)
govt_add.level: National Grade 10 board examination for transition to +2, A Levels, IB or 3 year CTEVT Diploma/PCL
govt_add.need: Completion of Class 9 registration and Class 10 regular or open-school attendance with at least 75 percent attendance
govt_add.age: No statutory age bar (Previously 14 years minimum; lifted by NEB)
stages: Written Board Examination (75 marks theory per subject, 3 hours)

National written papers across Compulsory English, Compulsory Nepali, Compulsory Mathematics, Science and Technology, Social Studies and two Optional papers; minimum 35 percent (27 out of 75 = Grade D) required in each theory paper under Letter Grading Directive 2078.
Internal / Practical Assessment (25 marks per subject) and Grade Upgrade (Chance) Exam
School practical and continuous assessment (minimum 40 percent = Grade C required); students scoring NG (Non-Graded) in any subject sit the NEB Grade Increment (Supplementary) exam in Shrawan/Bhadra.
subjects: Compulsory English, Compulsory Nepali, Compulsory Mathematics (100 marks full written)
Science and Technology, and Social Studies
Optional I (Additional Mathematics, Economics, Population, History, Geography or Computer) and Optional II (Computer Science, Accountancy, Education, Health or Technical stream papers)
prep: Secure at least 27 out of 75 (35 percent) in every theory paper; scoring below 35 percent in even one subject results in NG (Non-Graded) on the SEE gradesheet
Practise NEB CDC model question sets for Compulsory Mathematics and Science, where the highest NG rates occur
Aim for GPA 2.0+ with C in Science and Mathematics if you plan to enter +2 Science or CTEVT Health/Engineering diplomas
govt_add.note: Over 500,000 students sit SEE annually in Chaitra (March/April); the NEB registration and exam revenue stamp fee is NPR 500 (schools may charge small processing/practical fees).

govt_add.name: NEB Class 11 Enrollment and Class 12 National Board Examination (+2)
govt_add.level: Higher Secondary (+2 Science, Management, Humanities, Education, Law and Sanskrit) college entrance and Grade 12 national board exam
govt_add.need: SEE pass (minimum GPA 1.6 overall; selective +2 Science colleges require GPA 2.8 to 3.6 with C+ in Science and Mathematics)
govt_add.body: National Examinations Board (NEB), Sanothimi and Metropolitan / Municipal Scholarship Committees (such as KMC Entrance)
stages: College / Municipal Scholarship Entrance Test (100 marks)

After SEE results in Ashadh, selective +2 colleges (St. Xavier, SOS, Budhanilkantha, Sainik, Prasadi, Trinity, KMC) and metropolitan scholarship portals (such as Kathmandu Metropolitan City 10 percent scholarship exam) hold a 100 MCQ entrance test.
NEB Grade 11 (School Evaluated) and Grade 12 National Board Examination
3 hour written theory papers (75 marks, minimum 35 percent = Grade D pass) plus 25 marks practical/internal (minimum 40 percent = Grade C pass) held in Baisakh (April/May).
subjects: Compulsory English (Grade 11 and 12), Compulsory Nepali and Social Studies / Life Skill Education (or Mathematics)
Science stream: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology or Computer Science
Management, Humanities, Education and Law stream electives (Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies, Finance, Computer, Pedagogy, Constitutional Law, Jurisprudence)
prep: Apply for the municipal 10 percent institutional school scholarship test (such as KMC metro.kathmandu.gov.np) within 15 days of SEE results for a 100 percent free +2 seat
In Grade 12 boards, ensure at least C grade (50 percent aggregate) in Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Maths to remain eligible for MECEE-BL and IOE BE entrances
govt_add.note: NEB registration fee is NPR 400 in Class 11 and board exam fee is NPR 600 in Class 12 (total NPR 1,000 official NEB fee; Grade Increment chance exam is NPR 600 per paper).

govt_add.name: Cambridge International AS and A Level and IB Diploma Examinations (Nepal)
govt_add.level: Two year international pre-university qualification (equivalent to NEB +2 upon TU / CDC equivalence)
govt_add.need: SEE, GCSE / IGCSE or CBSE Grade 10 with strong English and subject grades (GPA 2.8 to 3.6+ at selective A Level schools)
govt_add.age: 15 to 20 years (Private candidates of any age may sit Cambridge exams through British Council Nepal)
govt_add.body: Cambridge Assessment International Education (via British Council Nepal) and International Baccalaureate Organization (IB)
stages: School Entrance Test and Interview (St. Xavier, Rato Bangala, Budhanilkantha, Chelsea, Trinity, Malpi, Ullens)
Written aptitude test in English, Mathematics and Science/Reasoning followed by student and parent interview in June/July.
Cambridge AS & A Level Series (May/June and Oct/Nov) or IB Diploma Final Assessment

Minimum 3 full A Level subjects plus AS English General Paper (3.5 credits) required for Tribhuvan University / CDC Class 12 equivalence; IB Diploma requires 6 subjects (3 HL + 3 SL) plus TOK, CAS and Extended Essay (minimum 24 of 45 points).
subjects: AS Level English General Paper (8021) plus 3 or 4 A Level subjects (Physics 9702, Chemistry 9701, Biology 9700, Mathematics 9709, Further Maths, Computer Science, Economics, Accounting, Business, Psychology, Sociology)
IB Diploma: Studies in Language and Literature, Language Acquisition, Individuals and Societies, Sciences, Mathematics and the Arts
prep: Always take AS English General Paper alongside at least 3 full A Level subjects so CDC / TU grants smooth +2 equivalence in Nepal
Science students targeting MECEE-BL (MBBS) or IOE BE must take Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Mathematics at full A Level and obtain CDC equivalence before entrance counselling
Private candidates can register directly at britishcouncil.org.np without paying private college tuition
govt_add.note: British Council Nepal standard exam registration costs about NPR 18,000 to 25,000 per AS/A Level subject (about NPR 75,000 across 3 A Levels + GP).

govt_add.name: TU Faculty of Management (FoM) BBS Campus Admission and Annual Board Exam
govt_add.level: Four year annual system Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) across TU constituent and community/private campuses
govt_add.need: +2 or equivalent in any stream with at least D+ grade in each subject (minimum CGPA 1.8 or Second Division 45 percent)
govt_add.body: Tribhuvan University, Faculty of Management (FoM) and Office of the Controller of Examinations (Balkhu)
stages: Campus Admission Form and Screening Test / Interview

Constituent campuses (Shanker Dev, Nepal Commerce Campus, Patan, Prithvi Narayan, Mahendra Morang) and community campuses screen applicants on +2 GPA and a campus aptitude test/interview in Bhadra/Ashwin.
Four Annual TU Controller of Examinations (OCE) Board Assessments (Year 1 to Year 4)
100 mark annual written board exams per subject plus 50 mark Fourth Year Final Project Report and viva.
subjects: Business English, Business Economics, Business Statistics, Principles of Management and Financial Accounting (Year 1)
Cost and Management Accounting, Business Law, Fundamentals of Financial Management, Taxation and Auditing (Years 2 and 3)
Entrepreneurship, Business Research Methods, Final Project Report and 3 Concentration Papers (Finance, Account, Marketing or Management in Year 4)
prep: Apply to Shanker Dev, Nepal Commerce Campus or your district QAA community campus immediately after Grade 12 results
Unlike BBA/BIM, BBS does not require central CMAT, making it the most affordable recognized 4 year management degree for Lok Sewa, banking and CA/ACCA parallel study
govt_add.note: Campus admission form fee is NPR 500 to 1,000; total 4 year BBS tuition at TU constituent campuses is NPR 35,000 to 60,000.

govt_add.name: TU Faculty of Education (FoE) BEd, 1-Year BEd and MEd Entrance Exam
govt_add.level: Four year BEd, 1-Year BEd (for non-education Bachelor graduates) and 2 year semester MEd
govt_add.need: +2 or equivalent with CGPA 1.8 / D+ for 4 year BEd; any 3 or 4 year Bachelor degree for 1-Year BEd; BEd with minimum pass division/CGPA for 2 year MEd
govt_add.body: Tribhuvan University, Faculty of Education (FoE), Balkhu
stages: Campus Admission (4 year / 1 year BEd) or Central FoE MEd Entrance Test (100 marks)

4 year BEd and 1-year BEd admit via campus screening at Mahendra Ratna Campus Tahachal, Sanothimi Campus and regional campuses; 2 year MEd requires a 100 MCQ FoE entrance exam (minimum 40 percent pass).
Teaching Practice (Practicum) and Semester / Annual Board Examinations
Compulsory school teaching internship, lesson plan portfolio and written examinations.
subjects: Foundations of Education, Educational Psychology, Curriculum and Evaluation, and Teaching Pedagogy
Major and Minor specialization subjects (English, Nepali, Mathematics, Science, Health and Physical Education, ICT Education, Economics, Geography, History, Special Needs)
Classroom practicum, action research and instructional supervision
prep: Graduates of BSc, BBS, BCA or BA who want to sit the Teacher Service Commission (TSC) secondary teaching licence exam must complete the 1-Year BEd (or 2 year MEd) to fulfill the education training requirement
Apply at Mahendra Ratna Campus Tahachal (mrc.tu.edu.np) or Sanothimi Campus (sac.tu.edu.np) during the Bhadra/Mangsir admission call
govt_add.note: Entrance/application fee is NPR 500 to 1,500; completing BEd or 1-Year BEd unlocks eligibility for the TSC teaching licence exam (g-tsc).

govt_add.name: NSTB / NVQS National Skill Testing Board Competency Exam (Level 1, 2, 3 and 4)
govt_add.level: National Vocational Qualification System (NVQS) occupational skill certificate across 300+ trades
govt_add.need: 390 hour training (or 1 year work experience) for Level 1; 1,692 hour training (or 1 year after Level 1 / Pre-Diploma) for Level 2; 3 year Diploma (or 2 years after Level 2) for Level 3
govt_add.body: National Skill Testing Board (NSTB / CTEVT), Sanothimi, Bhaktapur
stages: Written / Oral Occupational Knowledge Test (20 percent weight)
Short objective and oral safety/theory check in Nepali or English covering trade tools, occupational safety and measurements.
Practical Trade Performance Test (80 percent weight)
Hands-on demonstration of real occupational tasks (electrical wiring, plumbing, welding, culinary, caregiving, auto-mechanics, network cabling, tailoring) before certified NSTB assessors.
subjects: Occupational health, workplace safety and tool handling
Practical trade execution against the NSTB National Occupational Skill Standard (NOSS)
Quality inspection, troubleshooting and time-bound task completion
prep: Download the free National Occupational Skill Standard (NOSS) for your trade from nstb.org.np to see the exact practical tasks graded by assessors
Candidates trained under CTEVT, ENSSURE, Event or municipal free skill quotas sit the Level 1 or Level 2 skill test free of charge
govt_add.note: Per the NSTB tariff, self-financed Nepali citizens pay NPR 500 to 2,200 (Level 1 to Level 3), while donor/CTEVT quota trainees are tested free of cost. NSTB certificates are recognized by foreign employers and Lok Sewa technical posts.

govt_add.name: Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya, Nepal Police School and Budhanilkantha School Entrance
govt_add.level: Residential scholarship and full-fee entry at Class 5/6, Class 9 and Class 11 (+2 Science / Management)
govt_add.need: Age and previous class pass certificate (Class 4/5 pass for junior entry; SEE pass with GPA 2.8 to 3.6+ for Class 11 +2 Science/Management)
govt_add.age: 9 to 12 years for Class 5/6 entry; 15 to 18 years for Class 11 entry
govt_add.body: Nepali Army Welfare Directorate, Nepal Police Welfare Fund and Ministry of Education SEBS (Budhanilkantha School Scholarship)
stages: Written Entrance Examination (100 marks)
Objective and short-answer papers in English, Nepali, Mathematics, Science and IQ/General Knowledge held in Chaitra/Baisakh (Class 5/6) and Ashadh (Class 11).
Medical Fitness Check, Sports/Physical Screening and Interview
Physical height/weight/vision check and oral interview with parents.
subjects: English, Nepali, Mathematics and Science from the preceding grade curriculum
Analytical IQ, general knowledge and sports/co-curricular aptitude
prep: For the 100 percent free Ministry of Education scholarship at Budhanilkantha School (Class 5 entry), apply through your District Education Development and Coordination Unit (EDCU) in Falgun/Chaitra
For Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya (Bhaktapur, Pokhara, Surkhet, Dharan, Chitwan, Kailali, Bardibas, Sallaghari) and Nepal Police School (Sanga), check army/police quota vs civilian open merit seats
govt_add.note: Application form fee is NPR 500 to 1,000; Budhanilkantha SEBS scholarship covers up to 100 percent of boarding and tuition for selected rural community school students.

govt_add.name: Nepal Airlines Corporation (NAC) Cabin Crew, Officer and Ground Handling Lok Sewa Exam
govt_add.level: Cabin Crew (Air Hostess / Steward, Level 5), Senior Assistant (Level 5) and Officer (Level 6 / 7)
govt_add.need: +2 or equivalent in any stream with fluent English and Nepali, minimum height (158 cm female / 170 cm male), proportional BMI and clear vision for Cabin Crew; +2 for Level 5 Assistant; Bachelor degree for Level 6 Officer
govt_add.age: 18 to 25 years for initial Cabin Crew contract/permanent entry; 18 to 35 years (up to 40 for women) for Level 4/5/6 administrative and technical posts
govt_add.body: Nepal Airlines Corporation (NAC) and Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog)
stages: Physical Measurement, BMI, Vision and Preliminary Personality/Swimming Screening (Cabin Crew)
Height, weight, reach, eyesight, grooming and English communication screening at NAC Kantipath.
Lok Sewa Written Examination (Paper 1 and Paper 2, 200 marks)
Objective MCQ and subjective papers on Aviation GK, NAC Act 2019, ICAO/CAAN safety regulations, customer service, English and management.
Computer Test, Group Discussion and Final Interview
Practical/oral evaluation and medical fitness clearance under CAAN norms.
subjects: Nepal Airlines Corporation Act 2019, CAAN civil aviation regulations, ICAO standards and aviation safety
Tourism geography of Nepal, international airport codes, ticketing, cargo and passenger hospitality
English comprehension, business correspondence, GK and reasoning
prep: Maintain CAAN Class II medical fitness, swimming ability and strong spoken English before the NAC notice opens
Study the Nepal Airlines Corporation Act 2019 and CAAN passenger/cabin safety manuals for the Lok Sewa written papers
govt_add.note: Application fee at nepalairlines.com.np is NPR 800 for Level 4/5 and NPR 1,000 to 1,200 for Level 6/7 Officer.

govt_add.name: Nepal Insurance Authority (Beema Pradhikaran), SEBON and Rastriya Beema Lok Sewa Exam
govt_add.level: Assistant (Level 4/5) and Assistant Director / Officer (Level 6) in Insurance and Capital Market Regulation
govt_add.need: +2 in Management/Economics for Assistant; Master degree in Economics, Management, Finance, Actuarial Science, Statistics or Chartered Accountancy / Bachelor in Law for Assistant Director (Officer Level 6)
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years for Assistant, 21 to 35 years for Officer (up to 40 years for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Nepal Insurance Authority (NIA), Securities Board of Nepal (SEBON) and Lok Sewa Aayog
stages: Written Examination: Paper 1 and Paper 2 (200 marks)
Lok Sewa written papers covering insurance law, actuarial/risk management, capital markets, securities regulation, economics, accounting and financial analysis.
Computer Skill Test and Oral Interview
IT practical test (10 marks) and board interview (30 marks).
subjects: Insurance Act 2079, Securities Act 2063, Nepal Rastra Bank Act, Company Act and AML/CFT directives
Risk management, reinsurance, underwriting, claim settlement, actuarial valuation and NEPSE capital market operations
Macroeconomics, financial statement analysis, NFRS and public enterprise management
prep: Memorize the Insurance Act 2079 (which replaced Beema Samiti with the Nepal Insurance Authority) and SEBON mutual fund/issue directives
Graduates of TU SMSTU Actuarial Science (BMathSc), MBA, MBS and CA have a strong edge in the quantitative and regulatory papers
govt_add.note: Application fee at nia.gov.np and sebon.gov.np is NPR 800 for Assistant and NPR 1,000 for Assistant Director (+ NPR 200 to 400 per inclusive group).

govt_add.name: Lok Sewa Foreign Affairs Service (Pararastra Sewa Section Officer and Nayab Subba)
govt_add.level: Gazetted Third Class (Section Officer / Diplomatic Attache) and Non-Gazetted First Class (Nayab Subba) in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
govt_add.need: Bachelor degree in any discipline for Section Officer; +2 in any discipline for Nayab Subba
govt_add.age: 21 to 35 years for Section Officer; 18 to 35 years for Nayab Subba (up to 40 years for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog) and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA)
stages: First Phase: Administrative Aptitude Test (100 marks MCQ Prelim)
Common 100 mark GK, IQ and English MCQ screening paper (45 pass mark, 20 percent negative marking).
Second Phase: Common Papers (Governance + Contemporary Issues) and Foreign Service Specialized Paper (300 marks)
Two common 100 mark papers plus the 100 mark Foreign Service paper conducted in English on diplomacy, international law, geopolitical affairs and diplomatic drafting.
In-Basket Exercise, Group Discussion, IT Skill Test and Interview
Assessment center tasks, foreign policy presentation and board interview.
subjects: Foreign Policy of Nepal, UN Charter, Vienna Conventions on Diplomatic and Consular Relations, SAARC, BIMSTEC and WTO
International law, economic diplomacy, labour diplomacy, treaties, border management and LDC graduation of Nepal
English diplomatic note verbale, aide-memoire, press release drafting and speechwriting
prep: Unlike general Administration, the Foreign Service specialized paper must be answered in English; practise writing concise diplomatic notes and policy briefs
Tick Foreign Service alongside General Administration in the Mangsir Section Officer form (+ NPR 400 group fee)
govt_add.note: Advertised annually on the last Wednesday of Mangsir (Section Officer, fee NPR 1,000 + NPR 400) and Poush (Nayab Subba, fee NPR 700 + NPR 300). Selected officers serve at MoFA Singha Durbar and Nepal embassies/missions abroad.

govt_add.name: Lok Sewa Revenue Service (Rajaswa Sewa Section Officer and Nayab Subba)
govt_add.level: Gazetted Third Class (Revenue Officer) and Non-Gazetted First Class (Nayab Subba) under Ministry of Finance (IRD and Customs)
govt_add.need: Bachelor degree in Management, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Law or Statistics (or CA) for Revenue Section Officer; +2 in Management, Commerce, Economics, Maths or Public Administration for Revenue Nayab Subba
govt_add.age: 21 to 35 years for Section Officer; 18 to 35 years for Nayab Subba (up to 40 years for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog) and Ministry of Finance (Inland Revenue Department & Department of Customs)
stages: First Phase: Administrative Aptitude Test (100 marks MCQ Prelim)
Common 100 mark GK, IQ and English screening test.
Second Phase: Common Papers and 100 mark Revenue Administration Specialized Paper (300 marks)
Two common 100 mark papers plus the 100 mark Revenue Service paper covering public finance, taxation, customs, auditing and fiscal policy.
IT Skill Test, Group Discussion and Interview
Practical computer test and oral interview.
subjects: Income Tax Act 2058, Value Added Tax (VAT) Act 2052, Excise Duty Act 2058 and Customs Act 2064
Public finance, fiscal policy, annual federal budget of Nepal, revenue leakage control and tax auditing
Financial accounting, NFRS, double taxation avoidance agreements (DTAA) and WTO customs valuation
prep: Study the latest Finance Act changes announced in the federal budget on 15 Jestha, as tax slabs and customs rates are tested directly
Management, Economics, CA and Law graduates can apply for both General Administration and Revenue Service in the same Mangsir form
govt_add.note: Advertised annually in Mangsir (Section Officer, fee NPR 1,000 + NPR 400) and Poush (Nayab Subba, fee NPR 700 + NPR 300). Officers are posted to Inland Revenue Offices, Large Taxpayer Office and Customs offices nationwide.

govt_add.name: CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) Level I, II and III Examinations
govt_add.level: Global investment management, equity research and portfolio management charter (3 exam levels + 4,000 hours work experience)
govt_add.need: Bachelor degree (or within 23 months of graduation from a 4 year Bachelor degree for Level I entry; must hold a Bachelor degree before sitting Level II) plus a valid international passport
govt_add.body: CFA Institute (USA) via Prometric Computer-Based Test Centers in Kathmandu
stages: CFA Level I CBT (4.5 hours, 180 multiple choice questions)

Two 135 minute sessions (90 standalone MCQs each) covering Ethical and Professional Standards, Quantitative Methods, Economics, Financial Statement Analysis, Corporate Issuers, Equity, Fixed Income, Derivatives, Alternative Investments and Portfolio Management.
CFA Level II Vignette CBT and Level III Portfolio Management / Essay CBT

Level II tests 88 item-set (vignette) MCQs on asset valuation; Level III combines item-set vignettes with constructed-response (essay) portfolio management cases plus a Practical Skills Module (Python/Financial Modeling).
subjects: Ethical and Professional Standards (15 to 20 percent weight across all levels)
Financial Statement Analysis, Corporate Issuers, Equity Investments, Fixed Income, Derivatives and Alternative Investments
Quantitative Methods, Economics, Portfolio Management and Wealth Planning (plus Python or Financial Modeling Practical Skills Module)
prep: Register before the Early Bird deadline (6 to 7 months before the exam window) to save USD 300 per level
Apply for the CFA Institute Access Scholarship (open twice a year), which reduces the exam registration fee to USD 400 for selected Nepali candidates
Final year BBA, BBS, BMathSc and Economics students can sit Level I up to 23 months before graduation
govt_add.note: Per the 2026 CFA Institute fee schedule (effective February 2026): the one-time enrollment fee is eliminated, Level I and II cost USD 990 (early) / USD 1,290 (standard), Level III costs USD 1,090 (early) / USD 1,390 (standard), and Access Scholarship recipients pay USD 400 (USD 990 is about NPR 1,43,550). Held in Feb, May, Aug and Nov in Kathmandu.

govt_add.name: Lok Sewa Sub-Engineer (Level 5 Technical) and Assistant Sub-Engineer Exam
govt_add.level: Non-Gazetted First Class Technical (Level 5 Sub-Engineer) and Level 4 Assistant Sub-Engineer (Federal, Provincial and Local Levels)
govt_add.need: 3 year CTEVT Diploma in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Geomatics or Sanitary Engineering (or I.E.) for Level 5 Sub-Engineer; Pre-Diploma / TSLC in Engineering for Level 4 Assistant Sub-Engineer
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years (up to 40 years for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Federal Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog) and all 7 Provincial Public Service Commissions (PPSC)
stages: Written Examination: Paper 1 (Objective MCQ) and Paper 2 (Technical Subjective)

Paper 1 tests 50 multiple choice questions on engineering fundamentals and public management (100 marks, 45 minutes); Paper 2 tests descriptive technical calculations, estimating, surveying and construction supervision (100 marks).
Oral Interview
30 mark technical and competency interview before final merit recommendation to federal ministries, provincial infrastructure offices or municipalities.
subjects: Surveying, levelling, building construction, estimating and costing, irrigation, highway, water supply and sanitary engineering (for Civil Sub-Engineer)
Structural mechanics, concrete technology, AutoCAD drawing interpretation and public procurement rules
General knowledge, Constitution of Nepal and Local Government Operation Act 2074
prep: Practise 45 minute 50 MCQ past papers from both Federal PSC and Provincial PSCs (Bagmati, Koshi, Gandaki, Lumbini, Madhesh, Karnali, Sudurpashchim)
Sub-Engineer is the single largest government technical vacancy every year across all 753 local municipalities and provincial infrastructure offices
govt_add.note: Application fee is NPR 400 to 500 for Level 4 and NPR 500 to 700 for Level 5 across Federal and Provincial Lok Sewa portals.

govt_add.name: Lok Sewa Agriculture and Livestock Technician (JT / JTA, Level 4 and Level 5)
govt_add.level: Non-Gazetted First Class Technical (Level 5 Junior Technician / JT) and Level 4 Junior Technical Assistant (JTA) in Agriculture and Veterinary
govt_add.need: 3 year CTEVT Diploma in Agriculture (Plant Science or Animal Science / ISc Ag) for Level 5 JT; 18 month Pre-Diploma (TSLC JTA) or SEE Technical Stream in Agriculture for Level 4 JTA
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years (up to 40 years for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Federal Public Service Commission and Provincial Public Service Commissions (for 753 Municipal Krishi & Pashu Sakha posts)
stages: Written Examination (Objective MCQ + Subjective Technical Paper)
100 mark objective MCQ paper and 100 mark technical paper on agronomy, horticulture, plant protection, extension or animal husbandry, veterinary primary care and dairy.
Interview
30 mark oral interview.
subjects: Agronomy, horticulture, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, seed technology and agricultural extension (Plant Science group)
Animal nutrition, breeding, livestock management, poultry, veterinary pharmacology and infectious disease control (Animal Science group)
National Agriculture Policy, Prime Minister Agriculture Modernization Project (PMAMP) and local government agriculture service delivery
prep: Every rural and urban municipality in Nepal recruits Level 4 JTA and Level 5 JT staff for its Agriculture (Krishi) and Livestock (Pashu) sections via Provincial Lok Sewa
Revise Krishi Diary data published annually by the Agriculture Information and Training Centre (AITC)
govt_add.note: Application fee is NPR 400 to 700 across Federal and Provincial Public Service Commission portals.

govt_add.name: Lok Sewa Ranger (Level 5 Forestry) and Forest Guard (Ban Rakshak) Exam
govt_add.level: Non-Gazetted First Class Technical (Ranger, Level 5), Forester (Level 4) and Armed Forest Guard (Ban Rakshak)
govt_add.need: 3 year Diploma in Forestry (CTEVT / IOF) for Ranger; Pre-Diploma / TSLC in Forestry for Forester; Class 8 or SEE pass with strict physical fitness for Ban Rakshak (Forest Guard)
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years for Ranger/Forester (up to 40 for women); 18 to 30 years for Ban Rakshak
govt_add.body: Federal Public Service Commission, Provincial Public Service Commissions and Department of Forests / National Parks
stages: Physical Fitness and Endurance Test (Ban Rakshak and Armed Forest Service)
200m sprint, 3 km endurance run, tree climbing, swimming and eyesight/chest/height measurement (qualifying + scored marks for Ban Rakshak).
Written Technical Examination and Interview
200 mark written examination on silviculture, forest mensuration, community forestry, wildlife conservation and Forest Act 2076 (for Ranger) or 50 mark MCQ (for Ban Rakshak) plus interview.
subjects: Silviculture, forest management, forest mensuration, GIS/remote sensing, soil conservation and watershed management
Forest Act 2076, National Parks and Wildlife Conservation Act 2029, community forestry guidelines and biodiversity conservation
prep: For Ban Rakshak, train early for the 3 km endurance run, tree climbing and swimming tests, which carry direct marks before the written MCQ paper
For Ranger, focus on Forest Act 2076, Forest Regulation 2079 and community forest inventory calculations
govt_add.note: Application fee is NPR 200 to 300 for Ban Rakshak and NPR 500 to 700 for Forester and Ranger.

govt_add.name: Rajarshi Janak, Manmohan Technical, Gandaki, Lumbini Tech and Madhesh Ag University Entrance
govt_add.level: Bachelor and Master entrance across Federal (RJU) and Provincial Universities (MTU, GU, LTU, MAU)
govt_add.need: +2 Science with 45 percent or C grade in Physics, Chemistry and Maths/Biology for BE, BTech CS/AI, BSc Ag, BPharm, BPH and BSc MLT; +2 in any stream for BCA, BIT, BBA, BSM and LL.B
govt_add.body: Rajarshi Janak University (Janakpur), Manmohan Technical University (Morang), Gandaki University (Pokhara), Lumbini Technological University (Banke) and Madhesh Agriculture University (Saptari)
stages: University Objective Entrance Examination (2 hours, 100 marks)

100 multiple choice questions covering Grade 11/12 Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics/Biology and English (for STEM/Health/Ag) or Verbal, Quantitative, Logical and IT/Legal Aptitude (for IT/Management/Law); pass mark 40.
Provincial scholarship and constituent merit admission
Allocates 10 to 20 percent provincial merit and inclusive scholarships alongside subsidized public constituent seats.
subjects: Grade 11 and 12 Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (for BE Civil/Electrical at MTU, BTech CS & AI / IT at LTU, BIT at GU and BSc CSIT at RJU)
Biology, Chemistry and Agriculture fundamentals (for BSc Hons Agriculture at MAU Rajbiraj, BPharm/BPH at MTU/GU/RJU)
prep: Check rju.edu.np, mtu.edu.np, gandakiuniversity.edu.np, ltu.edu.np and mau.edu.np in Shrawan/Bhadra for constituent engineering, IT, pharmacy and agriculture seats at public tuition rates
govt_add.note: Application fee is NPR 1,000 to 1,500 across RJU, MTU, Gandaki University, LTU and MAU.

govt_add.name: Japanese Language NAT-TEST (Levels 5Q to 1Q, Kathmandu and Pokhara)
govt_add.level: Japanese language proficiency exam (5Q = JLPT N5 up to 1Q = JLPT N1) held 6 times a year in Nepal
govt_add.need: Open to all candidates with a valid passport or citizenship certificate
govt_add.body: Senmon Kyouiku Publishing Co. (Tokyo, Japan) via Kathmandu and Pokhara NAT-TEST Centers
stages: Language Knowledge (Vocabulary, Kanji and Grammar) and Reading Comprehension
Timed objective paper testing kanji, vocabulary and reading comprehension.
Listening Comprehension
Audio listening test (for 5Q and 4Q, total score is 180 marks with a 90 mark pass threshold and at least 25 percent in each section).
subjects: Hiragana, Katakana, N5/N4 Kanji and vocabulary
Japanese grammar patterns, particle usage and reading passages
Daily conversation and workplace listening comprehension
prep: Because JLPT runs only in July and December in Nepal, students applying for Japanese language school COE/visas frequently sit NAT-TEST 5Q or 4Q (held every even month: Feb, Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct, Dec) for faster results within 3 weeks
govt_add.note: Held six times a year in Kathmandu and Pokhara; the 2026 registration fee in Nepal is about NPR 4,500 (USD 35). Recognized by the Immigration Services Agency of Japan for student visa COE applications.

electrician.name: NSTB / NVQS National Skill Certificate (Level 1 to 3)

bank-officer.name: NRB / Public Bank Officer Exam or CFA Charter

guides_add.name: Take the NSTB / CTEVT National Skill Test (Level 1, 2 or 3)

faq_add.q: What is the minimum pass mark in SEE and Grade 12 under the NEB Letter Grading Directive 2078?
faq_add.a: Under the National Examinations Board (NEB) Letter Grading Directive 2078, a student must score at least 35 percent in the written theory paper (27 out of 75 marks = Grade D, 1.6 GPA) and at least 40 percent in the internal/practical assessment (10 out of 25 marks = Grade C, 2.0 GPA) in every single subject. Scoring below 35 percent theory in any subject results in NG (Non-Graded), requiring the student to sit the NEB Grade Increment (Supplementary) exam.

faq_add.q: How do I apply for the 100 percent free Class 11 (+2) scholarship at Kathmandu Metropolitan City (KMC) and municipalities?
faq_add.a: Within two weeks of the SEE result publication, Kathmandu Metropolitan City (metro.kathmandu.gov.np) and other municipalities open online applications for the mandatory 10 percent institutional school scholarship quota. Students sit a 100 mark MCQ entrance exam based on the Class 10 curriculum; selected students study Class 11 and 12 with 100 percent tuition waiver at private +2 colleges (with 85 percent of seats reserved for community school SEE graduates).

faq_add.q: How many Cambridge A Level subjects are required for Class 12 (+2) equivalence in Nepal?
faq_add.a: To obtain Class 12 (+2) equivalence from the Curriculum Development Centre (CDC, Sanothimi) and Tribhuvan University, a student must pass at least 3 full A Level (Advanced Level) subjects plus AS Level English General Paper (totalling 3.5 credits). Students aiming for MECEE-BL (MBBS/BDS) or IOE BE must take Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Mathematics at full A Level.

faq_add.q: Does TU BBS require the CMAT entrance exam and how much does the 4 year BBS cost?
faq_add.a: No. Unlike semester-based BBA, BIM/BITM, BBM and BHM, the 4 year annual Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) under Tribhuvan University Faculty of Management does not require the central CMAT exam. Admission is processed directly by constituent campuses (such as Shanker Dev, Nepal Commerce Campus, Patan, Prithvi Narayan and Mahendra Morang) and community campuses with a total 4 year tuition of about NPR 35,000 to 60,000.

faq_add.q: How can BSc, BBS, BCA or BA graduates qualify for the Teacher Service Commission (TSC) teaching licence exam?
faq_add.a: Graduates holding a non-education Bachelor degree (BSc, BBS, BCA, BA) must complete the 1-Year Bachelor of Education (1-Year BEd) or a 2 year MEd from Tribhuvan University Faculty of Education (offered at Mahendra Ratna Campus Tahachal mrc.tu.edu.np, Sanothimi Campus sac.tu.edu.np and regional constituent campuses) to satisfy the mandatory education training requirement for the lower secondary and secondary TSC teaching licence exam (although Science, Mathematics, English, Computer, Civil/Electrical Engineering, Agriculture and Animal Science graduates can sit the secondary licence exam directly under the Science/Technical exemption).

faq_add.q: What is the NSTB / NVQS National Skill Certificate and how much does the skill test cost?
faq_add.a: The National Skill Testing Board (NSTB under CTEVT, nstb.org.np) conducts competency tests (20 percent theory/oral + 80 percent practical trade demonstration) across 300+ occupations at Level 1 (390 hours), Level 2 (1,692 hours) and Level 3 (Diploma level). Self-financed Nepali candidates pay NPR 500 to 2,200, while trainees under CTEVT, ENSSURE or municipal skill quotas are tested free of cost.

faq_add.q: How does the Budhanilkantha School (SEBS) Ministry of Education free scholarship work?
faq_add.a: The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (via the Society for the Enhancement of Budhanilkantha School, SEBS) awards 100 percent and partial boarding scholarships at Budhanilkantha School (bnks.edu.np) starting from Class 5 for children from community schools across all 77 districts based on a written entrance exam in Nepali, English, Mathematics and General Knowledge plus parental income and geographic remoteness verification.

faq_add.q: How does Nepal Airlines Corporation (NAC) recruit Cabin Crew (Air Hostess / Steward) and Officers?
faq_add.a: Nepal Airlines Corporation (nepalairlines.com.np) recruits Level 5 Cabin Crew (+2 pass, age 18 to 25, minimum height 158 cm female / 170 cm male, fluent English and Nepali) and Level 4/5/6 Assistants and Officers through physical/medical/grooming screening followed by a 200 mark written examination conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog and a final interview (fee NPR 800 to 1,200).

faq_add.q: What is the eligibility for Nepal Insurance Authority (Beema Pradhikaran) and SEBON Officer exams?
faq_add.a: For Assistant Director (Officer Level 6) at the Nepal Insurance Authority (nia.gov.np) and Securities Board of Nepal (sebon.gov.np), candidates need a Master degree in Economics, Management, Finance, Actuarial Science or Statistics, or Chartered Accountancy (CA) / LL.B as specified in the group notice (age 21 to 35, up to 40 for women; fee NPR 1,000). Assistant Level 4/5 posts require +2.

faq_add.q: What is the difference between Lok Sewa General Administration, Foreign Affairs (Pararastra) and Revenue Service (Rajaswa)?
faq_add.a: All three are advertised together in the annual Mangsir Section Officer (and Poush Nayab Subba) Lok Sewa notice and share the 100 mark MCQ prelim and common Governance/Contemporary Issues papers. Foreign Affairs Service (open to any Bachelor) adds a 100 mark paper answered entirely in English on diplomacy, international law and diplomatic drafting, while Revenue Service (open to Management, Economics, Law, Statistics or CA graduates) adds a 100 mark paper on Income Tax, VAT, Excise, Customs and fiscal policy.

faq_add.q: How much does the CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) exam cost in 2026 and can Nepali students get a scholarship?
faq_add.a: Starting February 2026, CFA Institute eliminated the one-time enrollment fee; Level I and II registration costs USD 990 (early bird) or USD 1,290 (standard), and Level III costs USD 1,090 (early) or USD 1,390 (standard). Nepali students can apply twice a year for the CFA Institute Access Scholarship (cfainstitute.org), which lowers the registration fee to USD 400 per level. Computer-based exams are held in Kathmandu in February, May, August and November.

faq_add.q: Where is BICTE (Bachelor in Information and Communication Technology Education) offered under TU?
faq_add.a: The 4 year (8 semester) BICTE programme under Tribhuvan University Faculty of Education is offered at Mahendra Ratna Campus Tahachal (mrc.tu.edu.np, 72 seats), Sanothimi Campus Bhaktapur (sac.tu.edu.np, 72 seats), Surkhet Multiple Campus (sc.tu.edu.np), Myagdi Multiple Campus (myagdicampus.edu.np) and 28 constituent and community campuses nationwide via the FoE entrance exam.

faq_add.q: Which CTEVT constituent polytechnics offer 3 year Engineering, Geomatics, Agriculture and Forestry diplomas in Baglung, Khotang, Rolpa and Kaski?
faq_add.a: Dhaulagiri Polytechnic Institute (Balewa, Baglung, dpi.edu.np) offers Civil, Geomatics and Agriculture diplomas; Mahuregadhi Polytechnic Institute (Diktel, Khotang, mpi.edu.np) offers Civil Engineering and Forestry; Rolpa Polytechnic Institute (Mewang, Rolpa, rpi.edu.np) offers Civil Engineering, Plant Science and Animal Science; and Annapurna Polytechnic Institute (Dhampus, Kaski, api.edu.np) and Pokhara Technical School (ptspokhara.edu.np) offer Civil, Agriculture and Hotel Management diplomas.

faq_add.q: Where can I study BE Geomatics Engineering in Nepal?
faq_add.a: The 4 year BE in Geomatics Engineering is offered at Kathmandu University School of Engineering (Dhulikhel, 60 seats), TU IOE Paschimanchal Campus (WRC Pokhara, 48 seats), Purbanchal University affiliated Himalayan College of Geomatic Engineering / Geomatic Institute of Technology (Thapathali, Kathmandu, surveycollegenepal.edu.np, 30 seats) and Khwopa Engineering College (Bhaktapur).

faq_add.q: What scholarships are available at Nazarbayev University in Kazakhstan and AUCA in Kyrgyzstan?
faq_add.a: Nazarbayev University (Astana, admissions.nu.edu.kz) awards the Abay Kunanbayev International Scholarship covering 100 percent tuition, medical insurance and a monthly stipend of KZT 100,000 to 240,000 for English taught Bachelor, Master and PhD programmes. In Bishkek, the American University of Central Asia (auca.kg) provides 40 percent to 90 percent need and merit tuition aid for US-accredited Bard College degrees alongside the full-ride OSCE Academy Master Scholarship.

faq_add.q: Can Nepali students apply for the Silk Road International University full scholarship in Samarkand, Uzbekistan?
faq_add.a: Yes. As Nepal is a Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) dialogue partner, Nepali Bachelor graduates are eligible for the Silk Road International University of Tourism and Cultural Heritage full state grant in Samarkand (admissions.univ-silkroad.uz, April to August window), which covers 100 percent Master tuition, about USD 500/month stipend, USD 100/month hostel allowance and return flights.

faq_add.q: How do University of Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarships and University of Sydney Vice-Chancellor awards work?
faq_add.a: The University of Melbourne awards 600+ Melbourne Research Scholarships (MRS) annually to international Master by Research and PhD students covering a 100 percent fee offset, AUD 38,500/year living stipend (2026 rate), AUD 3,000 relocation grant and OSHC (automatic consideration when applying by 31 October at unimelb.edu.au). The University of Sydney offers AUD 5,000 to AUD 40,000 Vice-Chancellor International Scholarships for coursework degrees.

faq_add.q: What full scholarships exist in Canada beyond Lester B. Pearson and Vanier?
faq_add.a: The University of British Columbia (UBC) offers need-plus-merit International Leader of Tomorrow (ILOT) and International Major Entrance Scholarships covering up to full 4 year undergraduate tuition and living costs (deadline 15 November at you.ubc.ca), while McGill University awards 30 McCall MacBain Scholarships annually (mccallmacbainscholars.org, August deadline) covering 100 percent Master/professional tuition plus a CAD 2,300/month stipend.

faq_add.q: How does the Deutschlandstipendium and political foundation funding (KAS, Heinrich Boll, FES) work in Germany?
faq_add.a: Enrolled international students at German public universities can apply through their university for the Deutschlandstipendium (EUR 300/month = EUR 3,600/year regardless of income), while German political foundations (Heinrich Boll, Konrad Adenauer KAS and Friedrich Ebert FES) award Master stipends of EUR 992/month and PhD stipends of EUR 1,400/month plus health insurance to international students with strong academic and civic records.

faq_add.q: What undergraduate scholarships are available at NUS and NTU in Singapore for Nepali +2 or A Level students?
faq_add.a: The National University of Singapore (NUS Science and Technology Undergraduate Scholarship, nus.edu.sg) and Nanyang Technological University (NTU Nanyang International Scholarship, ntu.edu.sg) award 100 percent tuition coverage, SGD 6,000 to 6,500/year living allowance, SGD 1,750 to 2,000 computer grant and accommodation/flight allowances (November to March application window; NUS S&T carries a 6 year Singapore work bond).

faq_add.q: What university merit scholarships exist in Latvia, Georgia, Cyprus, Malta and the Philippines?
faq_add.a: Alongside government quotas, Riga Technical University (international.rtu.lv) and University of Georgia / TSMU (ug.edu.ge) award 20 to 50 percent semester merit waivers; Cyprus International University and Eastern Mediterranean University grant 50 to 100 percent international tuition scholarships; MCAST Malta offers EUR 1,000 to 3,000 bursaries plus 70 percent Get Qualified tax rebates; and IRRI / De La Salle University (irri.org, dlsu.edu.ph) fund graduate agriculture and STEM scholars in the Philippines.

faq_add.q: What are the 2026 exam fees in Nepal for IELTS, PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT and Duolingo English Test?
faq_add.a: In Nepal (2026 schedule), IELTS Academic (paper or computer via British Council and IDP) costs NPR 36,200 (UKVI NPR 39,000), PTE Academic costs USD 205 (about NPR 29,700), TOEFL iBT costs USD 200 (about NPR 29,000), and the Duolingo English Test (DET) costs USD 70 (about NPR 10,150, or USD 110 for a 2-test bundle). All four scores are valid for 2 years.

faq_add.q: What are the 2026 exam fees in Nepal for JLPT (Japanese), TOPIK (Korean), Goethe (German) and HSK (Chinese)?
faq_add.a: In Kathmandu, JLPT (N5 to N1 held in July and December by JALTAN) and TOPIK (I and II) cost about NPR 3,500 to 4,000; JFT-Basic at Prometric costs USD 36 (about NPR 5,000); EPS-TOPIK costs USD 28 (about NPR 3,850); Goethe-Zentrum Kathmandu German exams range from about NPR 14,000 (A1) to NPR 24,000 (B2); and HSK at Confucius Institute KU ranges from NPR 3,000 (HSK 1) to NPR 9,000 (HSK 6) plus HSKK.

faq_add.q: Where can I study MPhil and PhD in Education in Nepal?
faq_add.a: The Central Department of Education at Tribhuvan University Kirtipur (cded.tu.edu.np), Kathmandu University School of Education (Hattiban, Lalitpur, kusoed.edu.np) and Nepal Open University (nou.edu.np) offer MPhil and PhD programmes in Education, Educational Leadership, STEAM Education and English/Mathematics Education.

faq_add.q: Which TU constituent campuses in Baglung, Dadeldhura and Jumla offer low-fee BEd, BBS, BA and MEd degrees?
faq_add.a: Dhawalagiri Multiple Campus in Baglung (dmc.tu.edu.np) offers BSc, BBA, BBS, BA, BEd, MBS, MA and MEd; Dadeldhura Multiple Campus in Amargadhi (dc.tu.edu.np) offers 4 year BEd, BBS and 2 year MEd; and Jumla Multiple Campus in Chandannath (jc.tu.edu.np) offers 4 year BBS, BA and BEd at public constituent tuition rates.

faq_add.q: What is the total seat count and entrance fee for IOE BE/B.Arch and MECEE-BL in 2083/84?
faq_add.a: The TU IOE BE and B.Arch computer-based entrance exam charges NPR 2,000 and allocates 4,344 seats across 5 constituent campuses (2,040 seats at Pulchowk, Thapathali, WRC Pokhara, ERC Dharan and Chitwan Rampur) and 10 affiliated colleges (2,304 seats). The Medical Education Commission MECEE-BL exam charges NPR 4,000 and allocates 8,855 bachelor health seats across MBBS (2,745), BSc Nursing (2,640), BNS (1,160), BPharm (905), BDS (625), BPH (610) and allied health programmes.

faq_add.q: Which colleges in Lalitpur, Kathmandu and Rupandehi offer BPharm, BPH and BSc MLT under Pokhara and Purbanchal Universities?
faq_add.a: Modern Technical College (Sanepa, Lalitpur, mtc.edu.np) offers BPharm, BPH and BSc MLT under Pokhara University; Valley College of Technical Sciences (Maharajgunj, Kathmandu, valleycollege.edu.np) and CIST College (New Baneshwor, cist.edu.np) offer BPharm and BPH; and Sanjeevani College of Medical Sciences (Butwal, Rupandehi, sanjeevani.edu.np) offers BSc Nursing, PBBN and BPH under Purbanchal University via MECEE-BL.

faq_add.q: Which Purbanchal University engineering colleges operate in Biratnagar and Janakpur?
faq_add.a: In Biratnagar (Morang), Purbanchal University School of Engineering (PUSOE), Eastern College of Engineering (eascoll.edu.np, offering BE Civil 96 seats, BE Computer 48 seats, BE Electronics 30 seats and CTEVT Geomatics/Civil diplomas) and S. R. Engineering College (srengineering.edu.np) run NEC-recognized BE programmes. In Janakpur (Dhanusha), Central Engineering College (cecnti.com, 48 BE Civil seats) and Janakpur Engineering College (TU IOE affiliated) operate.

faq_add.q: When are Lok Sewa Section Officer, Nayab Subba and Kharidar notices published each year?
faq_add.a: Under the annual Public Service Commission (psc.gov.np) calendar, Gazetted Third Class Section Officer (non-technical/Judicial/Foreign/Revenue/Audit, fee NPR 1,000) is advertised on the last Wednesday of Mangsir (Nov/Dec), Non-Gazetted First Class Nayab Subba (fee NPR 700) on the last Wednesday of Poush (Dec/Jan), and Non-Gazetted Second Class Kharidar (fee NPR 500) on the last Wednesday of Falgun (Feb/Mar).

faq_add.q: How many scholarships and awards are tracked across the NEBians Pathways dataset?
faq_add.a: NEBians Pathways tracks 108 verified domestic and international scholarship programmes across all 46 study-abroad destinations and Nepal regulators (MEC, IOE, PU, KU, CTEVT, UGC, Indian Embassy, US Fulbright, UK Chevening/Commonwealth, DAAD, Australia Awards, MEXT, GKS, CSC, Stipendium Hungaricum, Erasmus Mundus and university excellence awards), with 100 percent of active scholarships carrying open-month windows and annual award counts.

faq_add.q: How do 3 year CTEVT Engineering Diploma graduates join government service as a Sub-Engineer (Level 5)?
faq_add.a: Graduates with a 3 year CTEVT Diploma in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Geomatics or Architecture Engineering apply for Non-Gazetted First Class Technical (Level 5 Sub-Engineer) vacancies advertised by the Federal Public Service Commission (psc.gov.np) and all 7 Provincial Public Service Commissions (fee NPR 500 to 700). The exam comprises a 100 mark objective MCQ paper, a 100 mark technical subjective paper and a 30 mark interview.

faq_add.q: How does the Lok Sewa JT / JTA (Agriculture and Livestock Technician) exam work for municipal Krishi and Pashu posts?
faq_add.a: Candidates with an 18 month Pre-Diploma (TSLC JTA) or SEE Technical Stream apply for Level 4 JTA, while 3 year CTEVT Diploma in Agriculture (Plant Science or Animal Science) graduates apply for Level 5 Junior Technician (JT) through Federal and Provincial Lok Sewa Aayog (fee NPR 400 to 700) for placement in the 753 municipal Agriculture and Livestock sections.

faq_add.q: What is the selection process for Forest Guard (Ban Rakshak) and Ranger in Nepal?
faq_add.a: For Ban Rakshak (Armed Forest Guard, minimum Class 8/SEE pass, age 18 to 30, fee NPR 200 to 300), Provincial and Federal PSCs conduct a scored physical endurance test (200m sprint, 3 km run, tree climbing and swimming) followed by a written MCQ paper and interview. For Level 5 Ranger (requiring a 3 year Diploma in Forestry from IOF or CTEVT), candidates sit a 200 mark technical written exam on silviculture, forest mensuration and Forest Act 2076.

faq_add.q: What programmes are offered by Nepal new provincial universities (Manmohan Technical, Lumbini Tech, Madhesh Ag, Gandaki) and Rajarshi Janak University?
faq_add.a: Manmohan Technical University in Morang (mtu.edu.np) offers BE Civil, BE Electrical and Electronics, BPharm, BPH and LL.B; Lumbini Technological University in Banke (ltu.edu.np) offers BTech in CS and AI (48 seats) and BTech in IT (48 seats); Madhesh Agriculture University in Rajbiraj (mau.edu.np) offers BSc (Hons) Agriculture (50 seats); Gandaki University in Pokhara offers BIT, BPharm and BSM; and Rajarshi Janak University in Janakpur (rju.edu.np) offers BSc CSIT, BCA, BBA, BPH and BSc MLT.

faq_add.q: What is the difference between JLPT and the Japanese NAT-TEST in Nepal?
faq_add.a: Both measure Japanese proficiency across 5 levels (JLPT N5 to N1 corresponds to NAT-TEST 5Q to 1Q) and both are accepted by the Immigration Services Agency of Japan for student visa Certificate of Eligibility (COE) applications. While JLPT is held only twice a year in Kathmandu (July and December, fee NPR 4,000), the NAT-TEST runs six times a year in Kathmandu and Pokhara (Feb, Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct, Dec, fee about NPR 4,500) with results issued within 3 weeks.

faq_add.q: Which CTEVT polytechnics in Arghakhanchi, Baitadi, Kailali, Dhankuta and Morang offer 3 year Engineering, Agriculture and Forestry diplomas?
faq_add.a: Agro-Forestry Polytechnic Institute in Chhatradev, Arghakhanchi (afpi.edu.np) offers 3 year Agriculture and Forestry diplomas; Bhimdatta Polytechnic Institute in Patan, Baitadi (bdpi.edu.np) and Tikapur Polytechnic Institute in Kailali (tpi.edu.np) offer Civil Engineering and Agriculture diplomas; Uttarpani Polytechnic Institute in Dhankuta (upi.edu.np) offers Plant and Animal Science; and Manmohan Memorial Polytechnic in Morang (mmp.edu.np) offers Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Civil and Architecture diplomas.

faq_add.q: Where can I study Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) and MPhil in English in Kathmandu under Purbanchal and Pokhara Universities?
faq_add.a: Kadambari Memorial College of Science and Management in Buddhanagar, Kathmandu (kadambari.edu.np) is the pioneer Purbanchal University college dedicated to the 4 year Bachelor of Social Work (BSW), while the Institute of Advanced Communication, Education and Research (IACER, New Baneshwor, iacer.edu.np) offers Pokhara University MA and MPhil programmes in English.

faq_add.q: Which community campuses in eastern hill districts (Taplejung, Panchthar, Ilam, Terhathum, Sankhuwasabha, Bhojpur, Solukhumbu) offer TU BBS and BEd degrees?
faq_add.a: Students in Koshi Province hill districts can study low-fee TU BBS, BA and BEd degrees at Pathibhara Multiple Campus and Sinam Multiple Campus (sinamcampus.edu.np) in Taplejung, Panchthar Multiple Campus and Rabi Campus (rabicampus.edu.np) in Panchthar, Mahendra Ratna Multiple Campus in Ilam (mrmcilam.tu.edu.np), Terhathum Multiple Campus in Chuhandanda, Barun and Madi Multiple Campus (madicampus.edu.np) in Sankhuwasabha, Bhojpur Multiple Campus (bhmc.tu.edu.np) and Shadananda Campus (shadanandacampus.edu.np) in Bhojpur, and Solukhumbu and Dudh Koshi Campuses in Solukhumbu.

faq_add.q: Which campuses and polytechnics serve students in Karnali and Sudurpashchim mountain districts (Dolpa, Mugu, Humla, Jumla, Bajura, Bajhang, Darchula, Baitadi)?
faq_add.a: Every mountain district in Karnali and Sudurpashchim has at least two public or community institutions in NEBians Pathways, including Karnali Technical School (kts.edu.np) and Jumla Multiple Campus (jc.tu.edu.np) in Jumla, Badimalika and Budhinanda Multiple Campus (budhinandacampus.edu.np) in Bajura, Jaya Prithvi and Sunkuda Campus (sunkudacampus.edu.np) in Bajhang, Gokuleshwor and Latinath Campus (latinathcampus.edu.np) in Darchula, Jagannath Campus and Bhimdatta Polytechnic (bdpi.edu.np) in Baitadi, plus campuses and CTEVT technical schools in Dolpa, Mugu and Humla.

faq_add.q: Does every single one of the 77 districts of Nepal have multiple colleges or polytechnics listed in NEBians Pathways?
faq_add.a: Yes. All 77 districts of Nepal across all 7 provinces have at least 2 verified public, community or private institutions (543 providers in total, with 450+ carrying verified official websites) mapped to the exact courses, entrance exams and seat quotas they run.
